Roles & Responsibilities:
 • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web and desktop applications using
 Selenium WebDriver and WinAppDriver
 • Develop, enhance, and maintain robust test automation frameworks (preferably using
 TestNG/JUnit)
 • Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into automated test
 scenarios
 • Work closely with development, QA, and product teams to ensure high-quality deliverables
 • Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines and ensure timely execution
 • Track, analyze, and report test execution results, defects, and coverage metrics
 • Identify areas for automation and continuously improve test efficiency and coverage
 • Participate in sprint planning, design discussions, and code reviews

 Strong experience in Selenium WebDriver & WinApp DriverProficiency in core Java & Javascript / Typescript 
 • Experience with automation frameworks like TestNG / Junit 

• • Knowledge of Page Object Model (POM) design pattern 

 • Experience with Maven 
 • Familiarity with Git / SVN 
 • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XPath, and CSS Selectors 
 • Hands-on experience in web application testing
